First release of Kamva, a desktop editor for designs, photos, video and audio.

## Download (Windows 10/11, 64-bit)

- **Kamva-Setup-1.0.0.exe**: installer with Start menu and desktop shortcuts; opens `.kamva` files
- **Kamva-1.0.0-portable.exe**: single file, no install needed
- macOS (Apple silicon, .zip) and Linux (.AppImage) builds are attached when those builds succeed

The builds aren't code-signed. If SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC", choose **More info → Run anyway**.

## Highlights

- Multi-page designs at any size (px, in, mm, cm), 32 size presets and 32 built-in templates
- Text with 40 bundled fonts plus your own; effects (outline, glow, neon, highlight, echo…) and curved text
- Shapes, lines and arrows, about 1,900 icons, emoji, charts, tables, QR codes and photo frames
- Photo editing: crop, 23 filters, 15 adjustments, background remover, masks, borders and shadows
- Video and audio: timeline, animations, page transitions, video trim and speed, audio tracks with fades, voice-over recording, presenter
- Brand kits, rulers, guides, snapping, layers, grouping, alignment, unlimited undo, light and dark themes
- Import images, video, audio, fonts, SVG and PDF
- Export PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, PDF, MP4, WebM, GIF, WAV, MP3 and editable `.kamva` projects
